name: Micware Co. Ltd. American Depositary Shares
summary: Micware Co., Ltd. specializes in providing advanced software development and IT solutions, with a primary focus on the global automotive and mobility industries. The company is deeply involved in the creation and commercialization of In-Vehicle Infotainment (IVI) systems, which integrate features such as automotive multimedia, navigation, human-machine interfaces (HMI), telematics, and driver assistance functionalities. Furthermore, Micware demonstrates expertise in developing sophisticated navigation software and smartphone applications powered by location-based information. The company organizes its business into three distinct operating segments: 1. Software Defined Vehicles (SDV): This segment concentrates on the development and distribution of software systems specifically engineered for SDVs, including core IVI system software and various other products designed to enhance mobility. 2. Location-Based Services (LBS): This division is dedicated to crafting and licensing in-car navigation software platforms, in addition to offering other geographic data-centric services to business-to-business clientele. 3. Other: This category encompasses general software development services for SDVs, alongside consumer-facing mobile applications that do not pertain to in-vehicle navigation. Founded in 2003, Micware Co., Ltd. is based in Kobe, Japan.
